problem.description: Normal samples lie near a curved support; test anomalies need not.

patchscore.description: Query scored by squared distance to the nearest stored normal vector.

svdd.description: Illustrative enclosing circle in fixed kernel feature space; not a fitted decision boundary.

deep_svdd.description: Schematic learned mapping concentrating normal representations near a fixed center.

drocc.description: Schematic pseudo-negative search around a normal point; the annulus does not exclude all other normals.

manifold3d.description: Analytic curved surface with tangent-aligned ellipsoids; a schematic, not benchmark data.

bubble_detail.description: A query projected onto the local tangent line; the dashed leg is the perpendicular residual.

pair_centers.description: Displacement between the two bubble centers.

pair_frames.description: Projectors compare subspaces, independently of sign changes in a tangent basis.

pair_thickness.description: Optional comparison of residual thickness; not a full covariance distance.

bubble_graph.description: Toy graph with bubble nodes and symmetric local edge weights; line width encodes affinity.

diffusion_walks.description: Two three-step transition distributions on the toy bubble graph, not a benchmark result.

attachment_near.description: Illustrative attachment mass in diffusion coordinates; circle area is p_j and star is the weighted mean.

attachment_far.description: Illustrative attachment mass in diffusion coordinates; circle area is p_j and star is the weighted mean.
